name: Excellence
description: Good enough is a decision, and it is rarely the right one. We sweat the second-order details — the empty states, the error copy, the loading feel — because that is where products earn trust.

name: Innovation
description: New for its own sake is noise. We adopt tools and techniques only when they make the work measurably better, and we prototype before we promise — curiosity with receipts.

name: Teamwork
description: You work with the people doing the work. No account managers, no telephone game — designers, engineers, and your team in one room, disagreeing usefully and deciding quickly.

name: Respect
description: For users, whose time and attention we never waste. For craft, which deserves better than shortcuts. And for each other — calm schedules, honest estimates, and no heroics culture.
